formal_statement: ∀ (x1 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) (x2 x3 : ℕ),   PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 x1 →     PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack (26 : ℕ) x1 →       x2 < (26 : ℕ) + x1.size →         x3 < (26 : ℕ) + x1.size →           have x8 : Finset (Fin (13 : ℕ)) := {(0 : Fin (13 : ℕ)), (1 : Fin (13 : ℕ)), (3 : Fin (13 : ℕ)), (9 : Fin (13 : ℕ))};           have x9 : Fin (13 : ℕ) → Fin (13 : ℕ) → List Bool := fun (x9 x10 : Fin (13 : ℕ)) => (List.ofFn fun (x11 : Fin (13 : ℕ)) => Decidable.decide (x11 = x9)) ++ List.ofFn fun (x11 : Fin (13 : ℕ)) => Decidable.decide (x11 = x10);           have x10 : Finset (Fin (13 : ℕ)) → List Bool := fun (x10 : Finset (Fin (13 : ℕ))) => (List.ofFn fun (x11 : Fin (13 : ℕ)) => Decidable.decide (x11 ∈ x10)) ++ List.ofFn fun (x11 : Fin (13 : ℕ)) => Decidable.decide (∀ x12 ∈ x10, x12 - x11 ∉ x8);           have x11 : Finset (Fin (13 : ℕ)) → Prop := fun (x11 : Finset (Fin (13 : ℕ))) => x11.card = (4 : ℕ) ∧ ∀ (x12 : Fin (13 : ℕ)), {x13 ∈ x11 | x13 - x12 ∈ x8}.card ≤ (2 : ℕ);           have x12 : ℕ → List Bool → Bool := fun (x12 : ℕ) (x13 : List Bool) => (x1.wires x13).getD x12 Bool.false;           (∀ (x13 x14 : Fin (13 : ℕ)), x13 - x14 ∈ x8 → x12 x2 (x9 x13 x14) = Bool.true ∨ x12 x3 (x9 x13 x14) = Bool.true) → (∀ (x14 : Finset (Fin (13 : ℕ))), x11 x14 → x12 x2 (x10 x14) = Bool.false ∧ x12 x3 (x10 x14) = Bool.false) → (∃ (x15 : Fin (13 : ℕ)) (x16 : Fin (13 : ℕ)), x15 - x16 ∈ x8 ∧ x12 x2 (x9 x15 x16) = Bool.true ∧ x12 x3 (x9 x15 x16) = Bool.false) → (∃ (x16 : Fin (13 : ℕ)) (x17 : Fin (13 : ℕ)), x16 - x17 ∈ x8 ∧ x12 x3 (x9 x16 x17) = Bool.true ∧ x12 x2 (x9 x16 x17) = Bool.false) → (63 : ℕ) ≤ x1.size
plain_statement: The plane of order 3 (13 points, 13 lines); a circuit of AND and OR gates, at most two inputs a gate, each reading earlier wires, on the 26 inputs, and two of its wires. If every incident point-line pair is accepted by one wire or the other, both wires reject every quadrangle input (four points, no three on a line, with every line missing them), and each wire accepts some incident pair the other rejects, then the circuit has at least 63 gates.
